myData.title: My data
myData.intro: Light Dey? has no name, phone number or email for you. Here you can see everything we hold, and delete it.
myData.downloadBody: A file with your settings, saved spots, points and every report you made.
myData.deleteBody: This removes your account, settings, saved spots, points and streak. Your past reports stay in the area statistics but are no longer connected to you. This cannot be undone.
myData.deleteConfirm: Yes, I understand this cannot be undone
myData.deleted: Done. Your account and data have been deleted.
myData.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
myData.noAccount: There is no account on this phone yet, so there is nothing to show or delete.
myData.admin: This is an administrator account. Another administrator has to remove it.
